response.sql: WITH combination_counts AS (SELECT ab.translink, tr.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref GROUP BY ab.translink, tr.tradekind), shares AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS share FROM combination_counts), benchmarks AS (SELECT tradekind, record_count, share, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS average_type_share FROM shares) SELECT tradekind, AVG(record_count::numeric) AS average_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_type_share) AS average_margin FROM benchmarks WHERE share > average_type_share GROUP BY tradekind;
